name: Convene the House Council
description: It is a time of crisis. In the lands of the ailing Empire, unruly vassals connive secession, whilst the Emperor's health grows worse by the day. To the west, Aquileia teeters on the brink of another civil war. To the south, the expansionist Wingbardy and her allies hungrily eye their neighbours. House Avian is surrounded by enemies, and a new strategy is needed if the House is to survive the turbulent years to come.

name: Go with Count Ehrenreich
description: Count Ehrenreich and his policy of armed neutrality is the way forward. Only through isolation will House Avian be safe from the madness outside its borders.

name: Go with Viceroy Joachim
description: Viceroy Joachim and his ideal of a union between the Three Great Houses of the Griffonian Heartlands is the path to Avian greatness, and protection from the great powers that would seek to engulf us.

name: Proclamation of Avian Neutrality
description: Whilst House Avian has remained neutral and aloof from any conflicts since its secession from the Empire, its neutrality has never been officially acknowledged. Declaring our intention to remain neutral in future conflicts will hopefully insulate us from the worst of the wars to come.

name: Avian Intergigantes
description: House Avian sits at the epicentre between three belligerent nations - the Empire, Aquileia, and Wingbardy. Trapped between the giants, House Avian must unite with its fellow Houses or perish.

name: Pursue True Neutrality
description: The feuding houses of Eyrie and Erie will never be able to put aside their differences, even to face a common foe. Like it or not, House Avian will have to go it alone; there is no point in bedding a corpse, even if there are two of them.

name: Overtures to House Erie
description: We lack a permanent representative within the court of House Erie, and any communication between House Avian and one of our officials is terribly slow. By establishing an embassy we will solve both problems in a single stroke.

name: Overtures to House Eyrie
description: Communication with House Eyrie, despite being neighbours, is problematic even at the best of times. Installing a diplomat from our house will ease these issues and open up new diplomatic options with House Eyrie.

name: Pursue Economic Cooperation
description: Alone, our economic might is paltry compared to those of larger nations. Only by forming new trade and economic deals between our houses will we stand to make an impression in the global stage.

name: Promote Inter-House Fraternisation
description: The once Great Houses of the Griffon Heartlands have long since fallen apart into tribalist factionalism that has only served to drive a wedge between our people. We are all griffons, and we are all griffons of the realms of the Three Houses.

name: Student Exchange Program
description: Looking closely at the different schools between the three houses, one is hard-pressed to find significant differences in the way that we teach and what our chicks learn. A way to nip the inter-house disdain would be to show our students just how similar we all are.

name: Three Houses Corporation
description: Previously one of the better examples of our houses' capacity to cooperate, the Three Houses Corporation can expand its scope into research and development if we encourage further investments from all three houses.

name: Relax Citizenship Requirements
description: Ancient Heartlands families have been forced apart due to the stringent citizenship requirements and travel permits between the houses' territories. Loosening some of these restrictions is not only morally the right thing, but a pragmatic move on having our people warm up to the idea of a single realm of the Three Houses.

name: Scientific Exchange Program
description: Each of the Three Houses have had their own research programmes that diverged and would often be contrary to the betterment of the Heartlands themselves. By allowing free movements of scientists and unifying our efforts, the Heartlands can begin to form a new hub of scholarly endeavours in Griffonia.

name: Common Market Agreement
description: With successful deals between the Three Houses bringing in wealth to every griffon, it only stands to reason that further economic integration will allow for greater prosperity among the Houses.

name: Inter-House Security Cooperation
description: We stand alone against the menace around our realms. Once the storm washes over our lands, the Houses must heed the call to stand as one.

name: Support the Tripartite College
description: With coalescing curriculums, there's no reason why we cannot form a single curriculum offered by a single college. A Tripartite College will further bolster a sense of unity among our generations and instil an identity not determined of the realm of the House they are from, but of our single inter-house entity.

name: Ending the Rivalry
description: The feud between House Eire and House Eyrie have continually been a hindrance to a unified House Realm, and any hope to achieve that dream starts with an end to the rivalry. Let us begin the arduous process, for a better future for our people.

name: The Annual Hunting Trip
description: The time is upon us: the yearly hunting trip where most of the House Avian nobles shall leave for the countryside. With all of the doom and gloom that permeates the courts, it is refreshing for the members of said courts to unwind and get in touch with their predator side. Hunting never got anyone killed, anyways.

name: Weekly Luncheons
description: The best way for rivals to get over their feud is to force them to see and treat each other as equals. House Avian can arrange for weekly lunches for members of both House Eire and House Eyrie. The first few events will be messy, but who knows? At least everyone will have a laugh.

name: The Winterfest Ball
description: The Winterfest Ball is a House Erie tradition, and has never seen a single member of House Eyrie attend since the start of their bloody rivalry. With proper preparations, we can break this sad streak and demonstrate just how far the two houses have come in mending their relationship.

name: The Scion Swap
description: Tensions have diminished between House Erie and House Eyrie, but there are many that are sceptical of a lasting peace. What better way to tie the two houses together via the exchange of two highborn noble scions? Montague Eyrie, Earl of Verenia, and Lady Rosaline Erie of Bantry have demonstrated an interest in this exchange.

name: Eyrie-Erie Treaty of Friendship
description: Bread was broken and shared, love has bloomed, and plenty of laughs were had between House Erie and House Eyrie. Were one to see these two houses interact without knowing their history, they would find it difficult to believe that they were ever at each other's throats. It is time to declare the Eyrie-Erie feud as officially over.

name: The Intergigantes Tripartite
description: With no further bad blood blocking the way, House Avian can finally set about to uniting the House Realms with an alliance that shall last forever or until the last griffon of the realms breathes their last. May our friendship last for decades!

name: A Unified Intelligence Agency
description: The spy networks of both Eyrie and Erie need to be unified along side House Avian's intelligence agency in order to keep watch over external and internal affairs. Even with our current Tripartite's ability to fend itself off from other powers, we must make sure we are able to detect any future threats through unified cohesian within our intelligence agency.

name: Annual Military Exercises
description: We should work with the other Houses to pursue full military cohesion through annual military exercises. Even though our past disunity brought about different military strategies, annual military exercises between all houses can bring about more needed experience and ability to change in order to fight any future wars.

name: A Unified Railroad Network
description: Each House's rail network is mainly internal and not connected with another. This needs to be fixed to bring about more unified commerce as well as faster military movement in case one of the Triparte members is attacked. Let's bring our rail together.

name: Interhouses Technological Cooperation
description: The Houses have been divided technologically for too long. We need scientists from each of the houses to be able to coordinate together to research new scientific breakthroughs that can further help our houses along in modernizing our Pact.

name: Prepare Constitutional Integration
description: The common markets, colleges and transport agreements have given Intergigantes practical weight. Commission a constitutional settlement to carry this cooperation towards one Verenia. Katrina will open the charter negotiations, test the first common institutions and then bring the question of a united government before a constituent convention. The Houses' authority must pass through agreed laws and ratification.

name: The Northern Defense Line
description: To the north lay the revanchist Empire and the Republic. Both will have designs on our land. We must be prepared.

name: The Southern Defense Line
description: To the south lay Wingbardy and her allies. They have already demonstrated their desire for expansion. We will be ready to meet them.

name: The Southeast Defense Line
description: To the Southeast is where the victor of the Prywhen Civil War is. They may come for us, and we must be ready for them.

name: The Western Defense Line
description: To the west lay Aquileia, and they too have shown their desire to absorb the rest of Griffonia; they shall meet our walls and be halted by them.

name: Form the Tripartite Legion
description: After years of division, feuding, hostility, and animosity between House Eyrie and House Erie, we as House Avian have been able put it all aside to work together. Not just work together, but we also have become brothers with the other houses during this turbulent period. Now we will lead both houses into a new future of security and order in which we can further our gains and help our houses prosper further.

name: A Common Military Leadership
description: It's time we unite our military leadership with the other houses and form a new chain of command under House Avian. The other houses will have their own chains of command but it will remain under our direction and guiding claw to make sure military coordination is successful.

name: The Second Winterfest Ball
description: After the success of the first Winterfest Ball, we should make an even bigger one in which all houses are already included, with more food, drink, music, as well as more grand speeches to showcase the common ground that every house has with each other. It's time we make our unity a true tradition to stand the test of time.

name: Support Local Companies
description: Our House needs to support more local companies in order for our economy to grow. Without healthy companies to keep employment high, as well as exports to keep being moved out, our economy will fall prey to foreign influences from both the Imperials, Aquileians, and even Skyfall.

name: Indigenous Manufactories
description: More indigenous_manufactories will not only increase employment, but also strengthen factory output for the many guns and shells needed to equip our growing military. It's time we encourage our own homegrown factories.

name: Agricultural Sustainability
description: We need to make sure our food supply is secure without needing to rely as much on trade. When war comes, a hungry populace will be a weak and weary populace.

name: Avian Protectionism
description: Our industry and economy is still relatively and developing. We should not free our trade to the world at this point, lest we have companies putting our fellow griffons out of business. Let's put some tariffs on goods to protect our populace.

name: Consolidate Avian Industry
description: Avian industry is too decentralized at this current point. Artisanry is still dominant in our less developed lands. We should have local industries starting to move and consolidate them in order for manufacturing to become more efficient.

name: Everygriff a Farmer
description: Even as our country becomes more industrialized, we should still encourage more farming in order to achieve our goals of agricultural self-sufficiency. Let's start agricultural education farmers to make sure everygriff knows how to do basic farming.

name: Material Self-sufficiency
description: We also need to be self-sufficient in raw materials. We should work towards becoming much more effective in conserving needed raw materials as well as producing them more efficiently as to prevent waste for our society to survive.

name: Localised Manufacturing Standards
description: Manufacturing standards should not be expected to be perfect with how decentralized the houses are, but we should enforce the provinces to have local manufacturing standards to help produce more guns from each house.

name: Cooperative Farms
description: With our farmer programs becoming successful, we should encourage cooperatives to be able to have our farms be more self-sustaining and more resistant to economic fluctuations. These cooperatives will not only strengthen our food production but the camraderie our fellow griffs have with each other.

name: State-Capital Alliance
description: It is time we need to align the directions of our state with the interests of capitalists. We need to make sure the forces of capital are on the same page as us in regards to our security, so we will work to assist these forces with their wealth while they work to help us consolidate our nation.

name: Infrastructure Modernisation
description: Our infrastructure is still haphazard and poor. It's unacceptable that our country still relies so much on dirt roads for trade. We must revamp our infrastructure and connect every town and city to modern and improved roads in order for our house to further flourish.

name: A Closed Agro-ecosystem
description: We need to keep our farmers protected and secure from the harmfulness of industrialization. Even with the necessity of industry, farmers should not be hampered by companies wishing to control it. We will enact protection laws to make sure farmers remain safe from industry.

name: Splendid Isolation
description: Our nation does not need to get involved in the chaos of Griffonian international politics as that could entangle house Avian in wars it does not need to fight and will not gain from. Our splendid isolation will keep our people at peace and prosperity.

name: Militarised Society
description: Even with our relative isolation from major Griffonian politics, we can never be too prepared in case of various powers wanting to eat our country whole and subjugate our people. All citizens will receive some form of basic training when they are of early adult age and be battle ready in case of invaders.

name: Fortify the Borders
description: We need to put more emphasis on our borders in order to protect against any of our possible rivals. We will most likely be less numerous and outgunned. So to combat this, we need more fencing, more watchtowers, and more bunkers to keep our country safe.

name: Mandatory Military Service
description: Every able-bodied adult griffon must be expected to serve for a number of years in order to bolster our ranks and help secure our borders. With all the possible invaders we have on all sides, House Avian must stand strong and make sure we have enough griffons to deter majors from simply attacking us without mutual bloodshed.

name: Weekly Rifle Practice
description: Every soldier should at least practice their accuracy and precision once a week with their rifles. This weekly practice will ensure our soldiers will be able to shoot properly in case of war.

name: Western Defenses
description: We must construct a line of fortresses along the western border in case of attack from either smaller nations like Flowena, or larger ones like Aquileia. These defenses will make them think twice before attacking us so hastily

name: Eastern Defenses
description: We must construct a line of fortresses along the eastern border in case of attack from either smaller nations like House Erie, or larger ones like the looming Griffonian Empire. Our defense will be vital since we have a larger border with Herzland.

name: Guns for Gilda
description: We have too many old guns. In the age of modern war, we need to break down these old models and make the newest of rifles in order to have our troops better equipped in any possible firefight with any attackers.

name: Muskets for Magda
description: There is not enough guns in our stockpile. Our troops have been underequipped for so long. There will be a new initiative to make sure we acquire as many guns as possible, even if they are of poorer quality.

name: Hidden Bunkers
description: We should lay some surprises for any possible invaders and put hidden bunkers filled with machine gun nests throughout our roads and path ways. These spots will be perfect for both ambush and harrassment

name: The Ehrenreich Redoubt
description: Our capital is the sacred center of power within our House. We must make some the most impregnable of modern walls and fences, as well as the most planned of machine gun nests in order to truly secure our capital from danger because if the capital is lost, our country will be lost in a short time.

name: A Decentralised Arsenal
description: There is no guarantee the enemy won't break our lines. In that scenario, we will make sure our arsenal is spread out enough so troops will be able to have access weapons in the case they are cut off, where ever they are.

name: The Avian Reservist System
description: It's time we establish a new reservist system where we will have a core amount of reserve troops to call up in case we go to war. We should have enough power to mount a more capable defense once we implement the new system.

name: Das Raubvogel
description: The Birds of Prey, an organization set up to not only ambush enemy lines, but to harrass and destroy supply lines. These partisan special forces will bring Tartarus to any enemy that is occupying out soil.

name: Avian Anti-air
description: The current state of our air defenses is pitiful. This nation needs to focus more on air defense research in order to combat enemy bombers. We will not have the planes to win so let's encourage more anti-air.

name: House Avian Stands Strong
description: Let it be known, that House Avian, as one of the oldest houses of Griffonia, will never bow to any foreign power, whether of Imperial power or Aquileian power. We will not simply surrender or give in. We will fight to the last, until we can't fight anymore.

name: Avian Military Act
description: The enaction of this act will allow our House to be able to reform the military from a group of rabble militia, into a proper professional army that is prepared for the upcoming future. We must learn new tactics and doctrines to be of upmost capability.

name: Avian Officer Academy
description: A new generation of officers is ready to be made and used for the full capabilities of the military. We should encourage as much talented officers as possible to rise the ranks and effectively strengthen our military.

name: Liberalise the Officer Corps
description: The current Officer Corps is filled with outdated ideas and old blood. It's time we open up the Officer Corps to new and modern ideas. Fresh officers will be able to bring new concepts and new skills to help strengthen the military leadership.

name: Aristocratic Officers
description: Our current Officer Corps is fine. We don't need commoners entering the Academy and tainting it with idiocy. If anything, having aristocrats ensures our army remains in the claws of experienced leaders that know the rules of war.

name: Recruit Commoner Generals
description: We need to open up the ability to be a general to commoners as well. There is plenty of younger minds ready to lead and defend this country. We just need to make things easier for them.

name: Favour House Retainers
description: Our current House retainers will be will suited to being good generals in the future. They will already have better starting experience than any peasant or lower class merchant wanting to join the army.

name: A Citizen's Milita Army
description: Even if it will take longer for peasant citizens to be trained, as well as less organized, it is much superior to have more griffons being able to wield guns than less, even with the limited griffonpower we have.

name: A Professional Standing Army
description: Discipline is key to a functioning army. We cannot rely on rabble to fight our wars. Thus, we need to make sure the Avian military has well-trained regulars prepared for intense combat on all sides.

name: Weapons Research
description: We need better rifles and better bullets in order to catch up with our rivals. So let's research weapons that any soldier can be proud of.

name: Artillery Development
description: Our artillery is outdated. We must research better barrels and better ammunition in order to rain Tartarus on our enemies.

name: Research Support Weapons
description: Every company needs support equipment. Whether it's trench equipment to make better trenches, or recon equipment to scout enemy positions. Our infantry need all the help they can get.

name: Favour Traditional Doctrines
description: Why trust new contraptions that have barely fought in the most recent of wars versus the tried and true. Knights have always been reliable and we must make sure to accomodate and adapt with what we already have.

name: Favour Modern Doctrines
description: Knights are outdated, a relic of the past. We need to move forward and focus on motorization of our army. The faster our army can move, the faster they can respond to crisis.

name: Local Tank Production
description: We should rely on the ingenious minds of our researchers in order to develop tanks faster and catch up. We cannot be too reliant on foreign powers for help.

name: Foreign Tank Licenses
description: It would be foolish not to look at the tanks of our rivals and possibly learn and take bits from their designs in order to increase our own. Our tank industry is at its infancy anyways.

name: Special Forces Effort
description: In the modern era of warfare, we cannot rely on purely infantry and knights, we need specialized infantry fighting in the air, sea, and mountains. More research needs to be allocated for that.

name: Military Radio Direction Ranging
description: Avian's military needs to incorporate radios. If we have radios in our entire military, we will be able to position and reinforce much faster than before.

name: Doctrinal Advancement
description: Whichever path we chosen, we need to refine our military doctrine in order to make our military not only the fighting force we made it to be, but an efficient one at what it does.

name: Form the Avian Aviation Auxiliary
description: The air is the soul of a griffon. We cannot let our skies become dominated by the enemy or we could get pummeled to dust by their bombers. We must rapidly advance fighter development to properly combat this and make sure we achieve air superiority.

name: CAS Effort
description: We will need better ground support in order for our forces to protect our country better. Let's make sure our air support gets the upgrades it needs.

name: Build Military Airstrips
description: We will create new airstrips for our burgeoning air auxiliary. Our planes will need as much room for our pilots to leave their hangars.

name: Tactical Bomber Effort
description: Our air auxiliary will get the best tactical bombers it needs to be able to give our air wings in edge in bombing our enemies factories and roads.

name: Instate the Avian Air Assault Academy
description: The Avian Air Assault Academy will be formed in order to create a new generation of paratroopers capable of effectively landing behind enemy lines. Their skill will make Avian proud.

name: Heavy Fighter Effort
description: It's not enough to have excellent fighters for claiming air superiority. Some bombers are far above normal range. We will need heavier fighters to combat them and protect our cities from harm.

name: Develop an Aerial Doctrine
description: Let's develop an aerial doctrine that can make our air auxiliary into a more effective air force. Once that is organized and prepared to fight in its own way.

name: Lishill Fighter Production Plant
description: After clearing the land needed for this project. We can now create the fighter production plant in order to be able to have more fighters not only replenish our wings but create more wings.

name: Hallhaus Radar Station
description: A radar station will be constructed to better assist our air wings in securing air superiority over our country. Without Radar, air superiority is less than possible.

name: Expand Plane Production
description: More planes must be produced to expand our air force! The assembly plants will have more lines in order to make production costs cheaper for our fighter planes.

name: Assert Ascendant Avian Aviation Ability
description: The time has come for Avian to assert its dominance over the skies. Possessing greater speeds then regular engines. Jets and rockets will certainty be the future of aviation. We must continue to prove our aviation ability by adopting these new technologies.

name: Acknowledge Advanced Aerial Accomplishments
description: Despite our small size. We have come to a forefrot of aviation advancement and skill. Griffons all over Griffonia know we have the best aircraft and our pilots are some of the best trained in the world. Should any foreign power try to strike us, they will find the Avian Airforce is more then capable of defending Avian.

name: Acknowledge Social Problems
description: The collapse of imperial authority has not been kind to Avian. Landlocked and without resources, our economy has stagnated. And while the Avian dynasty held on, our people impoverished itself. Let us end the masquerade.

name: Establish the Treasury
description: The imperial economic collapse threw the avian finances into utter chaos. A special commission known as the Treasury, or Cour des Comptes, will be set up to reorganize our tax collection and budget oversight in the flowenan tradition.

name: Strengthen the Avian Livre
description: When Avian declared independence, a new avian livre was created. However, political instability and mismanagement ruined the value of the new currency. This has only increased our problems due to how much our country relies on import. We shall raise our interest rates and rationalize our fiscal codes to strengthen the Livre.

name: Found the Avian Chamber of Commerce
description: Avian economic policies remain those of a pre-industrial time but gone are the times of the feudal obligations. We must consolidate our economic forces and further our interests at home and abroad with a clear strategy. We shall set up a Chamber of Commerce to do just that.

name: Language-neutral Inscriptions
description: Avian is not culturally united and our linguistic controversies slipped into the monetary debates. Many took offense at the wording used on our banknotes and coin and some stores and citizens even reject its use, thinking that they are foreign-made counterfeit. We will remedy to it by removing words requiring translation altogether.

name: A Commoners' Chamber
description: The creation of our Chamber of Commerce is well under way but due to old regulations, many commoners are still barred from joining it. By restricting participation in the Chamber on the basis of birth rather than merit, we are cutting ourselves from many competent and eager griffs. It is high time to remedy this and include the commoners into our plans!

name: An Aristocratic Chamber
description: The creation of our Chamber of Commerce has seen little participation from those who hold much of our wealth: the nobility. Avian gentlegriffs have been reluctant to join this innovative institution. We will make the Chamber an exclusive group and break this inertia by appealing to their pride. True meritocracy will have to wait.

name: The Linguistic Divide
description: Times have changed. A country cannot be defined by the language of it's nobles anymore, no matter how much we dislike this fact. We must evolve with the times and adapt if we wish to survive in this age. And to survive and thrive, we must address the linguistic issue.

name: Favour Aquileian
description: The answer to our problem is simple - all within our realm should embrace the great tongue of the Aquileians. While we are on a cultural and linguistic border, we cannot deny the fact that we have been part of the Aquileian cultural and political sphere for most of our history. We must respect the heritage of our great house. The Aquileian language is our past and it will be our future.

name: Linguistic Dual Hegemony
description: Despite what many claim, the two languages of our realm are not out weakness, it's one of our great strengths! It is proof that House Avian is something greater than just an extension of the Aquileian or the Heartlander sphere. We are a bridge between two great cultures and it is our duty to preserve this. While many believe it to be impossible, we will thrive as a bilingual state.

name: Favour Griffish
description: The answer to our problem is simple - all within our realm should embrace the great tongue of the Herzlanders. The Griffonian Empire may have been shattered, but the Heartlands are still the beating heart of Griffonia. While it is indeed true that historically we were Aquileian, we should look at the future, not the past. And the future lies in the Heartlands.

name: Codify the Aquileian Dialect
description: With the preparations done, new institutions of learning constructed and educators trained, the time to truly embrace our choice has come. From now on all schools and institutions of learning will only teach in the Aquileian language. While it might be a long and difficult task of returning back to the Aquileian cultural sphere, it's a necessary task to survive.

name: Local Dialects
description: Despite the minute size of our realm, parts of our populace speak in a dozen dialects. While some are fearful that allowing these languages to exist will only divide our country, such claims are simply absurd. We will not destroy this proof of our greatness and uniqueness because some are afraid of anything they dislike. We will preserve these languages and dialects and encourage their growth.

name: Codify the Imperial Dialect
description: With the preparations done, new institutions of learning constructed and educators trained, the time to truly embrace our choice has come. Never again will Aquileian be taught in any institution of learning as a "native" language, from now on Herzlander is the native language of the inhabitants of our realm. While many will rant and rave, we cannot allow ourselves to remain behind the times.

name: Adopt Imperial Drill
description: As our great house is aligning itself with the beating heart of Griffonia, we should not only look into their language, but also into what advancements they have made. The Griffonian Empire, the leader of the Heartlands, has been greatly expanding their armed forces and there is much we could learn from their offensive doctrine. And lucky for us, there are officers willing to share their knowledge.

name: Adopt Aquileian Drill
description: As we are returning to our roots, it only makes sense for us to follow Aquileia in other ways. And the Aquileians have been making great advancements in military sphere. The most notable of these is the idea of a large and organized "Grande Armée". While we can't field a large army, we can field a perfectly organized one. And it seems that there are quite a few Aquileian commanders wiling to help us.

name: Avian Welfare Act
description: Let's give our citizens the help they need in order to survive. Basic Welfare will be institute for all impoverished griffons needing assistance. This should not only reduce poverty, but better stabilize our nation.

name: Legislate Agrarian Reform
description: What's better for Avian is to make sure our farmers get more support. Agriculture makes up the backbone of this country. We cannot forget the roots of our nation come from the soil that was tilled.

name: Implement Urbanisation Policies
description: The future lies with industry. We need to encourage more farmers to work in factories, to consider switching to urban life to strengthen our economy as well as the prosperity of our people. Urbanization is the way.

name: Every Village a Manufactory
description: Every village at least needs a small manufactory. We will make sure our initivative to help villages get a little industrial production is a success in order to make villages more self-sufficient.

name: Aviaire Alloys
description: New mining techniques have allowed for better use of our resources, and thus we have more resources to use for our industries thanks to new alloys.

name: Agricultural Mechanisation
description: The days of using mainly hoes and sickles have come to an end. It's time for the age of the tractor to reach Avian.

name: Bolster Welfare Funding
description: We should expand our welfare system in order to satiate more of our impoverished griffons. Stronger welfare system means more love from griffons in struggle.

name: Finalise Industrialisation
description: It's time we finalize our industrialization in order for our nation to compete with our neighbors economically and strengthen our military capabilities. Our country will finally be a modern society.

name: Instate the Avian National Armoury
description: A national armoury must be created in order to facilitate the distribution of guns in an orderly manner to our militias and citizengriffs. In the case of war, a central Armoury will help organize the equipping process for our fighting force.

name: Support Avian Industry
description: Avian industry needs more economic funds in order to prosper. We should invest more in order for Avian to compete more in the manufacturing sector.

name: The Hallhaus Aerodrome
description: Currently, we not have much space to commit to air operations with any aircraft, whether commercial or military. In order to fix this, we should build an aerodrome to help our store aircraft in order to create a larger air force.

name: The University of Lishill
description: The University of Lishill will be established to educate a new generation of young Avaire griffons in new modern skills that can help us bring new research for our country, as well as bring in more skilled workers.

name: Expand the Aviaire Metalworks
description: With our current economic growth, we now have an opportunity to expand our metalworks in order to accomodate our growing industrialization. Let's commit to that.

name: Land Clearances
description: Even though we have a bunch of tenants on farms on the outskirts of Aviaire cities, we must evict them and clear out that space in order to expand our agricultural sector. After they are evicted, we can move them to a new sector.

name: Build the Lishill Oil Refinery
description: Oil is in such shortage for our burgeoning industrial state. We must build this refinery in the growing city of Lishill in order to shore up our oil deficiencies for both our civilian economy and military.

name: Finalise Education Reform
description: With the university established, we can now optimize our education system so we can direct some griffons to go to the university in order to better their skills and literacy.

name: The Communists Win
description: The revolution has succeeded! The reactionaries have either fled or been executed by our glorious Chairgriffon Redtail. With our victory, we can now work towards making our dreams of workers paradise a reality. The people can now reap the spoils against the bourgeoius scum.

name: The Strong Arm of the Revolution
description: The People's Aviaire Army must be formed and more griffons conscripted. With our victory, reactionaries and bourgeois neighbors will come knocking out our door in an attempt to destroy our paradise. Let's make sure we have enough bodies to fill our borders.

name: A Socialist Economic System
description: Capitalism will be abolished. All property belongs to the state, and by extension: the people. We must make sure to redistribute fairly and equally in order for the masses to be happy. No more wealth will concentrate to the highest of aristocrats.

name: The Long Arm of the Revolution
description: Even with the people achieving victory, there is still plenty of subversive agents ready to try and dismantle our paradise from within. We must reform the original Triparte Intelligence Agency into a vanguard to make sure our populace does not waver from liberal and reactionary lies.

name: Avian Collectivism
description: No more private farmers. Those farmers are basically small aristocrats anyways. All farmland will be collectivized and owned by the people and farmed fairly. All resources will be shared to make sure no one goes hungry.

name: A Socialist Education System
description: Every Aviaire griffon will be given a red book and be required to read at least 5 pages a day. If they cannot read because of illiteracy, they will have those words recited by loyal party members to make sure they understand the glories of socialism and why socialism is the only way forward.

name: Socialist Technocracy
description: We did it. Our socialist paradise is complete in formation. We can now progress beyond in science unparalleled as our people receive the nourishment they need and the learning they receive from our institutions. Let the worker have his spoils.

name: The Loyalists Win
description: It's over, we defeated our foes and have saved Avian from tyranny and ruin. With our victory complete, we can now reform the political system of Avian to be a system worth participating in for the people.

name: Purging the Army
description: The army must never get involved in Aviaire politics ever again. The army would only be a destructive tumor that will lead our country to only war and misery.

name: Purging the Aristocracy
description: The landed elite have had its parasitic prosperity for far too long. It's time we bring an end to it and only allow wealth from those that work for it and not just inherit it.

name: Liberalise the Government
description: The old government was hereditary, authoritarian, archaic, and broken. This old government must be broken and reformed into a liberal democracy. This democracy will allow for new blood and new ideas to sprout.

name: Support Harmonic Institutions
description: In order for Avian to remain a democracy, we need to foster haromonic institutions that espouse liberty, freedom, and justice for all. A new judiciary is a must, along with a new legislative body in order to foster civic participation.

name: Promote Civic Freedoms
description: Every citizen of this country deserves their civic freedoms. We will give them freedom of speech, assembly, faith, and freedom of press. These four freedoms will be mandated in our new and fledging constitution.

name: Permit Local Elections
description: It's time we now officially allow local elections in order to begin civic participation amongst our citizens and foster a new citizen that is aware, active, and kind to their fellow brothers and sisters of our nation.

name: The Coup Succeeds
description: Our glorious leader Zypressen has won against both the Federalists and leftist technocrats wishing to ruin our great state. With victory achieved, we can now work towards fully consolidating Avian into a militarized state prepared for war to form a greater Verenia.

name: Purging the Army
description: Although it was his allies within the armed forces of House Avian that backed him during his coup and put him on the Avian throne, there are still elements of the army that remain loyal to the House and the departed Lady Avian, not to mention rival cliques in the military. Only by liquidating all opposition within the armed forces can the Lieutenant-General solidify his rule.

name: Purging the Aristocracy
description: The aristocracy have been a thorn in our side for far too long. We must scour this country, purge every single noble. We don't need their decadent behavior to be tolerated anymore.

name: Adopt the Stahlhaube
description: We need new helmets that are capable of more easily stopping bullets from downing our troops. The Stalhaube is an excellent helmet to make standard-issue for our troops. Along with that helmet, we should also make sure to give soldiers the basic shovel and binoculars as well to be more effective.

name: Reintegrate Haustruppen Auxiliaries
description: The Haustruppen Auxillaries must be re-integrated because our army is one army only now. All troops will be fighting under one banner, under one army, and one unit in order to more effectively defeat our enemies.

name: Reform Military Organisation Structure
description: Our military needs new restructuring. No more will we have archaic structures that the aristocracy created to simply keep their peasants in line. The military structure will be modern and organized by merit.

name: Restructure the Secret Service
description: The original Triparte Secret Service was a good start to a needed organization to protect against foreign spies but now it must be remade and made sure to not only watch for foreign subversives but domestic subversives as well who wish to weaken the integrity of our state.

name: Restructure the Ministry of Economics
description: The Ministry of Economics needs massive restructuring in order for it to handle our militarized state. It needs to be repurposed for our neverending rearmament was we prepare to manufacture as many weapons as possible.

name: Restructure the War Office
description: The War Office's original purpose was to prepare for defense against our enemies. But defense is weakness. We must be prepared to invade and secure our safety through war, and thus our office will be repurposed for mass conscription for such use.

name: Strengthen Military Rule
description: The Aviaire people need to be reminded that the military is the biggest reason our country has stayed safe. We must keep it that way and for that to happen, we will use commit to mass military parades to show the people our strength.

name: Artillery Improvement Effort
description: Our army needs to prioritize artillery. The better artillery we have, the better we can pummel infantry and break their lines.

name: Armour Improvement Effort
description: Tanks are the future of warfare. We need to invest in a future that will be filled with these gigantic machines pummeling our enemy into the dirt.

name: Societal Improvement Effort
description: Along with how our military functions, our society must be in full cohesion with the military. Every single person will be a cog, united and strong, to fight our enemies.

name: Motorised Improvement Effort
description: The use of motorized cavalry can potentially change Avaiare warfare for our good. Motorized forces can outmaneuver so many units.

name: Mechanised Improvement Effort
description: Let's work on improving our mechanized forces and make them faster, stronger, and more able to fight more rapidly against our enemies.

name: Declare the Kingdom
description: The Kingdom is formed! It is time we retake our rightful place in Griffonia and make our neighbors bend to their knees in the awe of our realm.

name: Reclaim Griffonstone
description: The heart and soul of the griffon belongs to us. We are the true inheritors of the old and it is time we retake our rightful place against the likes of old Gruff and his terrible rule.

name: Reclaim Flowena
description: The Bank of Griffonia is ours! How long have the merchants and noble houses of Flowena squandered the potential of its city through parties and decadence. No more, it's time for us to save it.

name: Reclaim Pomovarra
description: Pomovarra will be ours now. This minor land needs to be conquered and established as a part of our glorious kingdom in order for them to prosper.

name: Reclaim Adelart
description: Merlock Wood and his merry bandits have been plaguing the Adelart lands for far too long. It's time we arrest these hooligans and re-establish order in adelart.

name: Form the Archduchy
description: The Archduchy will be formed in order to protect the lands of the people and establish a new peace within those lands.

name: Integrate Copperhill
description: We must make sure we let the citizens now that they are safe under our rule. The people of Copperhill will come to love us.

name: Reinstate the Kingdom
description: With the likes of corrupt Gruff off the beautiful ancestral homeland of Griffonstone, we can now reform ourselves into a new and improved Kingdom of Griffonstone under a dynasty worth its blood and soil.

name: A Zypressen on the Imperial Throne
description: Whose to say a Zypressen isn't worthy of the Imperial Throne? The past decades have been filled with failure by the dynasty of Grovers that failed to keep Griffonia stable and prosperous due to their own incompetence and weak health. Fresh blood is needed now.

name: The Foundation Welcomed
description: We now have a new foundation for military strength, let's build upon that foundation for success.

name: Establish Secure Facilities
description: We need new facilities for our military to be successful. Let's make these facilities to better safeguard the nation.

name: Form Mobile Task Forces
description: Modern militaries need faster responses to crisis in order to effectively protect the nation, we can form mobile task forces to respond more rapidly to crisis.

name: Centralise Foundation Control
description: Now with the Foundation established, let's centralize control in order to better strengthen our military and make it more efficient.

name: Reassemble Foundation Personnel
description: We need top personnel as soon as possible! Let's quicken our recruiting process to get more skilled people into the Foundation.

name: Relocate Foundation Laboratories
description: Current laboratories are unsafe and insecure. We need to relocate our facilities to more secure locations that are less likely to be found and attacked.

name: Foundation Scientific Expansion
description: Research must be expanded in order to find new discoveries for our military to exploit. We must expand our pool of scientists and engineers for the good of our country.

name: Foundation Infrastructure Expansion
description: In order to strengthen our network, we need more infrastructure, roads that connect our facilities and makes it easier for scientists to move between facilities, as well as troops.

name: Foundation Military Expansion
description: The more soldiers to protect our facilities the better. Let's make sure we have the skilled military troops needed to protect the work we created.

name: On-site Nuclear Devices
description: Nuclear testing should be done on our facilities. With the potential power in nuclear research, it would be beneficial to secure those sites for nuclear testing.

name: The Price of Our Inheritance
description: Vincent Erie inherited a claim to Verenia, unpaid suppliers and a frontier where every repaired bridge might become tomorrow's battlefield. Iovinus Eyrie's ancestry offers an answer as convincing as his own. Before choosing a settlement with his cousin or a campaign against him, Vincent must hear what either course will ask of the country that pays for it.

name: An Inheritance We Can Share
description: Vincent can keep his claim to Verenia without making every neighbour live beneath the threat of his army. He will seek a settlement with Eyrie: hear the country, let the family speak, and accept guarantees that bind his own officers before asking Iovinus to disarm the feud. This choice closes the road to imposing his inheritance by conquest. If the other court refuses, Erie must still have a future worth building.

name: A Hearing for the Living
description: Petitions arrive wrapped in deeds, casualty notices and invoices that nobody expects to be paid. Their authors have practical questions for the duke: when may a cart cross the border, who repairs a ruined workshop, and where is a missing brother? Receiving them in public would make their demands harder to forget. Receiving them privately would leave more room for the court to bargain.

name: Kinship Beyond the Feud
description: Rosaline Erie of Bantry and Montague Eyrie, Earl of Verenia, have kept a personal connection alive where their elders see only competing claims. Lady Katrina is aunt to both dukes; the family knows how to reach the other court without bringing an ultimatum. Vincent will protect that opening, not purchase it with a marriage promise. The first people allowed across the boundary must be free to speak for themselves.

name: Silence Along the Frontier
description: The grievances have been heard, the families have spoken and the safeguards have been chosen. Now Vincent must make restraint an order his captains cannot mistake for a pause before the next raid. Patrols will cease crossing the line to seize cattle or settle an old insult. This armistice will hold while the Houses build a permanent settlement, without an anniversary telling their officers to resume the feud.

name: The First Cart Across
description: A barricade can be removed in an afternoon. A damaged culvert, a disputed toll and a carrier who has lost three carts require more work. Engineers and local officials will reopen the roads of our own territory while the ceasefire holds. Each ordinary journey completed safely will make the next agreement a little less difficult to imagine.

name: The Price of Restraint
description: The petitioners want more than a promise that this season will be different. A farmer asks who will stop the next patrol; a dispossessed family asks who will answer for the last one. After hearing them and establishing contact across the family divide, Vincent must put something of his own behind the peace. Joint patrols would expose his officers to scrutiny. A restitution fund would oblige his court to acknowledge damage done in his name. He cannot demand a concession while refusing every cost of his own.

name: The Treaty of Friendship
description: The reopened crossing has given both courts something their genealogists could not: an example of life without the feud. The treaty will turn that experience into a settlement. Vincent and Iovinus relinquish their demands upon each other's lands and end the privileges that kept the quarrel alive. Neither receives a defeated cousin's submission. Each receives a neighbour whose independence is no longer an unfinished war.

name: Who Speaks at the Congress?
description: The court can appoint household delegates who know every title and precedence. Towns and parishes can send representatives who know which bridge still needs timber. Giving the latter a place will consume political capital and complicate bargaining, but their participation can give an equal council a public purpose beyond accommodating two dynasties.

name: An Intergigantes Association
description: Katrina's council chose to work between the giants, not to shut its doors. Offer Avian a treaty that makes cooperation the first step towards a common state. Its municipal charters and colleges must have a place in the eventual constitution. The first signature opens that work; only a later accession act can transfer sovereignty.

name: A Charter of Agreed Powers
description: The treaty has quieted the frontier; it has not decided who may speak for a common court, a shared workshop or the next dispute between the Houses. With delegates appointed and Avian offered a seat, Vincent must put a constitution before the congress. An equal council gives each partner the same standing. A limited ducal presidency promises continuity, but asks his cousin to accept a chair that Vincent alone would occupy. The peace is already real. The question is what they will build upon it.

name: Orders the Other Side Can Read
description: The quartermasters have discovered that their supply returns describe the same shortages in incompatible columns. A joint staff will bring the returns, maps and exercise plans to one table. Officers must learn to ask for another House's cooperation without mistaking a colleague's signature for authority over his troops.

name: Standards Across the Border
description: A replacement part should fit regardless of which House paid for it. Engineers will compare drawings, test each other's measurements and take the disputed pieces back to the workshops. The common technical offices must earn their authority at a workbench, where a seal cannot conceal a badly cut thread.

name: A Judgement Against the Duke
description: Our common court has received a claim to an estate promised to one of Vincent's own veterans and patrons. The former owners belong to a family divided by the old battle lines. Their documents are sound. The charter will mean little unless its judgement can reach a beneficiary of the duke's personal word.

name: An Agreement to Stand Together
description: Staff cooperation can prepare a defence, but only a further agreement can commit the Houses to a military league. We shall develop support methods and offer Eyrie a defensive partnership where existing commitments permit it. Avian, if a charter partner, will receive its own invitation. Each government must consent to the obligations it takes on.

name: Finish the Work We Promised
description: The first petitions were about livelihoods, not constitutional diagrams. We must complete the works promised at home, bringing new civilian production into service where we still hold our territory. The public commitments can then be discharged. Those who asked the duke for help deserve something more substantial than a copy of the charter.

name: A Generation Without the Feud
description: The union will be judged by the habits it makes possible: a court obeyed, a consignment delivered, a dispute settled without calling the reserves. Vincent has not forgotten his inheritance. He is learning what authority becomes when others accept its exercise and can hold it to its word. Let that be the settlement the next generation receives.

name: The Country We Can Rebuild
description: The shared settlement has failed, whether at the first safeguards or at the final charter. A refusal cannot be signed away, and a fallen neighbouring government cannot keep a dead ruler's promises. Vincent can still keep his own: the schools, workshops and roads will not wait for another congress. Whatever agreements remain valid will be respected. Whatever was never agreed will not be invented. We chose negotiation, not an invasion postponed until an unwelcome answer.

name: The Work of Reconstruction
description: Neglected bridges, leaking roofs and unanswered petitions have become ordinary features of life in Erie. We will establish a small reconstruction office to survey the damage, arrange deliveries and give local repair crews a reliable point of contact. Its authority will rest on work completed.

name: Restore Public Services
description: Clean wells, working dispensaries and dependable local offices matter to families long before grand plans reach them. Repair crews will restore these services first, while regular inspections keep them from falling into neglect again. A household should not have to spend its last savings on failures the administration could have prevented.

name: Reopen the District Roads
description: The roads of Erie, Balefire and Comrick must carry grain, tools and travellers in every season. Repaired bridges, drainage ditches and maintained surfaces will reconnect isolated settlements with their markets. The engineers' surveys will also guide our next construction projects.

name: A Civilian Industrial Base
description: Our builders need reliable supplies of timber, fittings and machine parts. Expanding civilian production will give local firms steady contracts and put more of that work within reach. This is one step towards an industrial economy, with much still to be built.

name: Connect the Workshops
description: A workshop can grow beyond its founder's tools when it can order standard parts and train apprentices to use them. We will expand manufacturing premises and bring willing workshops into a common system of measurements, inspections and orders. Small producers will retain their craft while learning to supply a larger market.

name: A Trade After Service
description: Returning soldiers bring practical skills, but a service record is no guarantee of a livelihood. A new placement scheme will match veterans with apprenticeships, repair crews and workshop jobs, with suitable work for those carrying lasting injuries. Experienced volunteers can also help prepare the next intake of recruits.

name: Schools Within Reach
description: Children should not lose their chance to learn because the nearest classroom is a day's journey away. We will reopen neglected rooms, provide basic books and offer evening lessons to adults. Reading, arithmetic and an introduction to practical science will make further study possible for more households.

name: Train the Teachers
description: Opening a classroom is easier than finding someone prepared to teach in it. New teacher courses will combine supervised lessons with arithmetic, record keeping and elementary technical subjects. Graduates will return to local schools with materials they can use and colleagues they can consult.

name: Found a Technical College
description: With schools and civilian workshops in place, we can establish a modest technical college. Its first laboratories will teach mechanics and electrical measurement, while workshop placements keep instruction close to practical problems. This new institution will give Erie's growing scientific community a place to train its successors.

name: From Lessons to Research
description: The college can now support a small team working on problems beyond the classroom. A functioning civilian industrial base and an understanding of electrical engineering will let researchers build instruments, test designs and record results. Sustained research needs a budget, equipment and time as well as promising ideas.

name: Coordinate Research
description: Our expanding factories and trained workforce can sustain a broader scientific programme. We will form a small research council to share laboratory time, award practical commissions and publish useful findings. Once basic machine tools and construction methods are established, a second permanent research team can begin work.

name: Books Beyond the Classroom
description: School leavers need somewhere to keep learning. Public reading rooms will lend practical manuals, newspapers and stories, while travelling librarians carry books to settlements too small to maintain a collection of their own.

name: A Place for Every Pupil
description: A school is public only when every family can use it. Attendance officers will work with parents, teachers and employers to bring missing pupils into class, and adult tutors will welcome those whose childhood passed without that chance.

name: Homes Fit for Work and Rest
description: Crowded lodgings and leaking roofs consume the wages that should keep a household secure. District builders will repair rented homes and lay out affordable housing near the workshops, with residents able to demand repairs without risking eviction.

name: Security Through Hard Times
description: Illness and injury should not send a working family back to the poorhouse. Employers, workers and the treasury will sustain an insurance fund whose local offices pay claims promptly and answer openly for the money entrusted to them.

name: Credit for the Countryside
description: Farmers and village tradespeople need loans that can be repaid from honest work. Local credit associations will share risks, publish their terms and keep emergency borrowing from becoming a lifetime of dependence.

name: Water, Power and Public Works
description: Growing towns need dependable water, lighting and transport. Engineers and elected district representatives will agree on common service standards, extend reliable networks and train the crews who must keep them working through every season.

name: Prosperity That Reaches Home
description: The rebuilding programme must finally reach the households still left behind. Secure homes, steady work and dependable services will become ordinary expectations, with local authorities responsible for carrying prosperity beyond the busiest streets.

name: An Army for the Country
description: The army must be able to defend the settlements, roads and livelihoods entrusted to it. A review of unit rolls, stores and training will show what our formations can actually do. From that accounting we can build a force whose duties extend beyond ceremony and personal allegiance.

name: Professional Officers
description: A commission carries responsibility for supplies, training and the lives of subordinates. Regular staff courses and exercises will give officers a common grounding in those duties. Promotion should recognise demonstrated competence and the ability to keep a unit ready for service.

name: Modern Infantry Equipment
description: Infantry cannot depend indefinitely on incompatible weapons and improvised replacement parts. Comparative trials will identify practical rifles and squad equipment that our workshops can maintain. The results will inform both procurement and the drills used to train their crews.

name: Engineers and Field Medics
description: A damaged crossing or an untreated wound can end a campaign as surely as enemy fire. We will organise specialist training for engineers and medical detachments, and test equipment suited to their work. These companies must be able to move and serve alongside the infantry.

name: Expand the Arsenal
description: A dependable arsenal needs gauges, inspection benches and workers who understand the equipment they produce. New military workshops will expand our capacity to manufacture and repair weapons. Artillery trials will help ensure that future orders suit the army we can maintain.

name: A Permanent Supply Service
description: Each formation must know where its next delivery will come from and how to request it. A permanent supply service will standardise inventories, loading schedules and the maintenance of transport. Trials of motor vehicles and specialist logistics equipment will turn these plans into usable field procedures.

name: A Staff That Works Together
description: Infantry officers, engineers, medical staff and quartermasters need to plan the same campaign. Joint exercises will test how their work fits together and reveal where orders fail to reach the units that need them. A shared staff system will preserve those lessons for the next mobilisation.

name: Rebuild the Borderlands
description: Eyrie's recovery begins with work that cannot wait for a settlement abroad. We will appoint local repair crews, inventory public buildings and give district officials the authority to keep essential services running.

name: Fair Grain Markets
description: Uncertain weights, spoiled stores and arbitrary charges leave farming households with little of what they earn. Common market rules and shared storage will ease rural poverty and help local savings find their way into civilian industry.

name: Roads to Market
description: A harvest is worth little when it cannot reach the mill. In Verenia and Eyrie, carriers know which bridge will fail in the rain and which road disappears beneath the thaw. Their accounts will guide the drainage crews and bridge builders, so that a farmer can promise a delivery without first guessing the weather.

name: Process the Harvest at Home
description: Milling, preserving and packing should provide skilled work close to the farms. Too much of the harvest leaves Eyrie's villages unprocessed, and too much of its value stays with distant buyers. Local processing works will let farming families sell goods that can travel farther and keep through the winter.

name: Equipment Cooperatives
description: Smallholders cannot each maintain an expensive workshop. Equipment cooperatives will pool their orders, keep spare parts in common stores and repair tools between harvests. A broken machine should bring a mechanic to the farm, not a creditor to the farmhouse.

name: Work Between Harvests
description: Seasonal work should not mean seasonal hunger. District offices will match willing workers to processing plants and repair jobs outside the harvest months. More dependable household incomes will reduce poverty further and strengthen confidence in the rebuilding programme.

name: Evening Classes
description: Schoolrooms can serve adults after the day's work is done. A new programme of reading, arithmetic and technical drawing will reach those whom ordinary schooling has missed and make practical study a lasting part of village life.

name: Science for Everyday Work
description: Our new classes and processing workshops need instructors who can test a material, explain a circuit and record an experiment. Modest teaching laboratories will strengthen a still-limited scientific base and prepare the ground for electrical research.

name: District Laboratories
description: The district schools have begun borrowing instruments from the workshops, whose foremen now bring their own questions to the teachers. Shared laboratories will give this exchange a permanent home. Materials can be tested, circuits assembled and failed experiments kept on record, instead of each instructor having to begin again alone.

name: Technical Fellowships
description: Our instructors cannot build a scientific community in the hours left after marking exercise books. Paid fellowships will let promising researchers devote themselves to a difficult problem and bring apprentices into the work. The workshops that supply their instruments will expect useful answers, but must learn to allow time for an honest experiment.

name: Teachers for Every District
description: A village school cannot depend on whichever clerk has an afternoon to spare. Residential courses will prepare teachers to lead a classroom, keep useful records and return to their districts with colleagues they can call upon.

name: Books Beyond the Classroom
description: School leavers need somewhere to keep learning. Public reading rooms will lend practical manuals, newspapers and stories, while travelling librarians carry books to settlements too small to maintain a collection of their own.

name: Prosperity That Reaches Home
description: The rebuilding programme must finally reach the households still left behind. Secure homes, steady work and dependable services will become ordinary expectations, with local authorities responsible for carrying prosperity beyond the busiest streets.

name: A Defensive Service
description: Defending Eyrie requires clear duties, dependable training and officers who know the ground. We will review local defence plans and use practical exercises to establish a common standard of service.

name: A Skilled Reserve
description: Soldiers returning to civilian life should not have to choose between a livelihood and their place in the reserve. Workshop apprenticeships will give them trades, while refresher courses keep former comrades accustomed to serving together. Employers and officers must agree on a calendar that does not summon a worker away whenever an order comes due.

name: A Field Engineer Corps
description: Drainage, covered positions and sound fieldworks matter more than grand plans drawn far from the border. A permanent cadre of engineers will teach units to entrench quickly and guide the development of better engineering equipment.

name: Repair Arsenals
description: A rifle awaiting a minor repair is still a rifle missing from its unit. Armourers need benches, gauges and a dependable supply of replacement parts. A properly equipped arsenal will let them mend worn weapons before another regiment has to march with whatever happens to be left in the stores.

name: Organise the Supply Depots
description: The quartermaster knows what his ledger contains; the driver knows what actually reached the depot. Too often their accounts describe different consignments. A permanent depot service will reconcile receipts, maintain transport schedules and make someone answer for supplies lost between the warehouse and the unit that needed them.

name: Practical Infantry Drills
description: Small units must be able to hold a position, cover a withdrawal and use their weapons effectively. Regular field exercises will reveal shortcomings in our infantry equipment and give instructors experience they can pass on.

name: Border Observation Sections
description: Local knowledge is useful only when a report arrives clearly and in time. Trained observation sections will compare patrol reports, keep accurate sketches and develop better reconnaissance methods for the troops guarding the border.

name: A Common Signals Network
description: A patrol's warning is useless if headquarters reads it after the reserve has marched the wrong way. Observers, depot staff and reserve officers will practise exchanging the same reports through trained signallers. The message must remain intelligible from the first field notebook to the last unit waiting for orders.

name: Three Seals, One Constitution
description: Katrina's Intergigantes has brought the Houses from rivalry to friendship. Its next task is to prepare a united Verenia. Begin with separate signatures on a common charter, so that courts, accounts and public offices can earn the authority a single country will need. The Houses retain their governments during this first settlement; the constitutional convention will decide how those powers pass to a common government.

name: Two Legible Copies
description: An agreement is of little use when its readers disagree about what it asks of them. A professional translation office can produce reliable common records and make technical knowledge more accessible, at a continuing administrative cost. Locally appointed clerks can instead draw on familiar voices and existing relationships. Neither arrangement can settle every cultural division within Avian, but both can give its common business a more dependable language.

name: The Towns Have Their Own Questions
description: A congress agenda can give every House a seat while leaving the towns outside the door. Invite carriers, workshop representatives and local authorities to describe where cooperation would change their working day. Their petitions will inform our construction methods and expose promises that have not yet acquired a responsible office. Peace must become usable beyond the reception room.

name: The First Constitutional Charter
description: Submit the charter to Erie and Eyrie, then seek Avian's own ratification. Common courts and services will be the first institutions of the future Verenia. Their present jurisdiction must be explicit, and each House must accept its obligations. This provisional division of powers gives the later convention an enforceable foundation for a common treasury, citizenship and government.

name: Contributions by Consent
description: Avian's treasurer has drawn up three columns, but only one government can promise the sums in the first. Katrina will send Erie and Eyrie the proposed accounts and ask what each is prepared to contribute. Shared roads and workshops need dependable funding; a courteous reply cannot pay a supplier, and a blank signature cannot become a debt.

name: The Work Between the Houses
description: A road crossing a border brings different specifications, maintenance records and suppliers into the same undertaking. Put the charter's shared technical services to work on those differences and give Avian's engineers opportunities to improve industrial methods. Coordination can make future construction more useful without giving our offices the right to order work on another House's land.

name: A Staff with Agreed Limits
description: The common staff should know both what its officers can arrange and what requires a further political decision. Develop shared planning, improve support methods and give Avian's officers experience of working with their counterparts. These practical preparations do not themselves create a military alliance or place the other armies under our command.

name: The Host Before the Court
description: Hosting a congress cannot exempt Avian from the rules agreed within it. Katrina will acknowledge the common court's jurisdiction in the matters entrusted to it, including disputes involving her own administration. More reliable records and communications can help the institutions do their work. Their authority must reach the office that supplies the meeting room.

name: Read the Budget as Signed
description: The treasurer must turn the Houses' replies into a programme he can actually fund. Some proposed works may have to wait; others can proceed with fewer partners. Katrina will have the signed obligations read beside the estimates. The charter's credibility now depends on an account that neither conceals a refusal nor spends a contribution nobody promised.

name: The Levy Nobody Authorised
description: An emergency circular demands timber, metalwork and transport beyond the contributions the Houses agreed. Its author has attached the congress seal where the suppliers expected a warrant. Katrina must answer for an office acting in her name. If the host can enlarge an obligation whenever its stores run low, every signature beneath the charter becomes a promise made on someone else's terms.

name: Make the Exemptions Real
description: The suppliers who planned around their exemptions need more than a corrected circular. Let Avian's works offices bring them orders they can fulfil without surrendering the materials promised to other customers. We shall support civilian industry and better building methods, putting our own resources behind the obligations we accepted. A workshop should be able to plan its next season without wondering whether the host will confiscate its output.

name: Workshops That Can Plan Ahead
description: Reliable orders let workshops exchange methods without wondering whether their next consignment will be seized as an emergency contribution. Bring engineers and production specialists together to pursue improvements in industrial technique. Their research will strengthen Avian's capacity to cooperate through practical knowledge and predictable civilian work.

name: Defence Under Civil Authority
description: The common staff needs officers who can work together and engineers who can maintain the same defences. Train them under the charter's civilian authority. The present commands remain responsible for their forces while the convention prepares the laws and appropriations needed for a unified army. Avian's experience will help turn coordination into a service of the future state.

name: Minutes That Can Be Read Outside
description: Publish the levy dispute, its resolution and the obligations that remain. The towns must be able to judge how the first common institutions have used their powers before they are asked to entrust more to a united government. These records will accompany our delegates to the constitutional convention.

name: A Mandate for United Verenia
description: The charter has survived a dispute over money and authority. Its courts can bind the host, its offices can publish honest accounts, and its workshops can plan beyond a season. Conclude this first settlement and open a constituent convention. The next negotiations will establish common institutions and choose the government that will bring the Houses into one country. Avian can seek that responsibility under the same ratified constitution.

name: Neighbours Without a Common Chair
description: The charter negotiations have not produced a common government all can accept. Preserve the friendship already concluded and turn the practical knowledge gathered during the talks towards construction. Katrina can continue to mediate between independent neighbours without treating their refusal as ingratitude. Another congress may become possible; the peace need not wait for it.

name: The Avian Question
description: Our settlement with the other duchy does not settle Avian's future. Katrina's Intergigantes government has already made cooperation its policy; a government committed to true neutrality has chosen the opposite. Our council must address the Avian question in its own right, not append it to the old family quarrel.

name: From Association to Administration
description: The duchies now share a government. Avian's accession needs working instructions: common customs documents, recognition of municipal law, and a place for its colleges in the public budget. Once these are ready, Katrina's council will receive the act that ends separate sovereignty.

name: Close the Third Frontier
description: Consent has been given and the transition has run its course. Avian's regiments will enter the common army, its courts the common system of appeals, and its towns the same political country as their neighbours. The treaty becomes a constitution in practice.
